title: Tip can get clogged
text: Tip can get clogged. This is a cute little dish soap dispenser but you can’t overfill it (it’s really hard to tell when you’re close to the top) and the tip gets clogged with dish soap because it’s so small.

description: The soap dispensers bring a modern style to your kitchen or bathroom. The specially crafted spout delivers a precise amount of soap or detergent with a simple squeeze of the dispenser. Easy-to-remove spout allows for easy refills and cleaning. Tired of hold large club size soap detergent when cleaning dishes? Look no further this refillable soap bottle is the answer to your problem. This bottle can be refill as many time as you like.
